input.quote: Section 3.1 Engagement. The Issuer engages Cellco as the Servicer of the Receivables for the Issuer and the Indenture Trustee, and Cellco accepts this engagement.
input.rationale: The agreement imposes no exclusivity, "sole supplier" or requirements-purchase obligation on our side (Issuer/Depositor), which meets the preferred position. Searches for "exclusive"/"sole" return only the Cap Collateral Account control provisions (Sections in Article IX), non-exclusive jurisdiction in Section 10.6, and "sole remedy"/"sole discretion" usages — none of which restrict our freedom to engage other providers. The Section 3.1 engagement of Cellco as Servicer (and the Section 3.10/3.11 custodian and marketing agent appointments) is a structural single-servicer appointment rather than an exclusive dealing covenant, and it is not stated to be exclusive; Article VII expressly permits Servicer resignation/termination on Servicer Termination Events and the engagement of a Successor Servicer (including an unaffiliated institution servicing consumer receivables), so there is no term-length lock-in and no performance-exit gap. Nothing to redline.
